title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw two circles in the first loop and second loop. The first circle has a center at [0.0349, 0.0349] with a radius of 0.0349, while the second circle has the same center but a radius of 0.0312. Apply a sketch scale of 0.0699 to the entire 2D sketch. Rotate and translate the scaled 2D sketch using the same Euler angles and translation vector as initially set. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.06988188976377953 units in length, 0.06988188976377953 units in width, and 0.7500000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0349, 0.0349)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0349)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0312)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.0349, 0.0349)
radius_outer = 0.0349
radius_inner = 0.0312

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle (for the hole)
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Cylinder with through hole
cylinder_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0349).extrude(0.75)
cylinder_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.025).extrude(0.75)

# Subtract cylinder_2 from cylinder_1
r = cylinder_1.cut(cylinder_2)

# Part 2: Top slot
top_slot = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(-0.004, 0.025).lineTo(0.004, 0.025).lineTo(0.004, 0.035).lineTo(-0.004, 0.035).close().extrude(0.75)

# Cut top slot from the model
r = r.cut(top_slot)

# Part 3: Bottom chamfer
bottom_chamfer = r.faces(">Z").chamfer(0.001)

# Apply chamfer to the top and bottom edges
r = r.faces(">Z").edges().chamfer(0.001)
r = r.faces("<Z").edges().chamfer(0.001)
